title: HiFi Gibson Assembly Protocol for NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7kchksw
materials: NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix

steps.title: Prepare assembly reaction
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble a 20 µL HiFi DNA assembly reaction according to the recommended component volumes.

steps.title: Incubate assembly mixture
steps.instruction: Place the reaction in a thermocycler at 50 °C; incubate for 15 min if assembling 2–3 fragments, or for 60 min if assembling 4–6 fragments.

steps.title: Store post‑incubation mixture
steps.instruction: After incubation, keep the reaction on ice or store at –20 °C until ready for transformation.

steps.title: Transform into competent cells
steps.instruction: Introduce 1–5 µL of the assembly reaction into chemically competent cells, or use 1 µL (diluted 10×) or 5 µL of the reaction with electrocompetent cells after salt removal purification.
